API reference

Every page here is generated by sphinx.ext.autodoc from the modules’ own docstrings, so there is one description of each function rather than two that can drift apart. Autodoc imports each module to read them, which every module tolerates with no database running: models builds its Engine on first use, and nothing else opens a connection until it is asked a question.
